# TokenVector Media Downloader

> Ultra-lightweight media downloader (~32KB) written in TokenVector (.tkv),
> compiled to native .NET CIL. Downloads YouTube, Facebook and TikTok videos
> on Windows, Linux and macOS. Zero dependencies: no Python, yt-dlp or FFmpeg.

## Binaries (use these, do not rebuild unless changing source)

- `tv-downloader-gui.exe` (~32 KB): WinForms GUI — YouTube formats, HLS,
  transcripts, progress bar, STOP button, Facebook/TikTok download.
  Windows: double-click. Linux: `xvfb-run mono tv-downloader-gui.exe`
  (needs `mono-runtime libmono-system-windows-forms4.0-cil libgdiplus xvfb`).
  macOS: Mono MDK + XQuartz, then `mono tv-downloader-gui.exe`.
- `tv-downloader-cli.exe` (~25 KB): `tv-downloader-cli.exe <media_url>
  [c_user] [xs]` (Linux/macOS: prefix with `mono`). Facebook saves as
  `facebook_video.mp4`, TikTok as `tiktok_video.mp4`.

## CLI JSON mode (for AI agents)

Add `--json` in any position. Stdout is exactly one JSON line
(a bare return code may follow on its own line — ignore it):

```text
{"status":"ok","platform":"tiktok","file":"tiktok_video.mp4"}
{"status":"error","platform":"facebook","code":3,"message":"No video link found"}
```

Fields: `status` = `ok` | `error`; `platform` = `facebook` | `tiktok` |
`unknown`. Error `code`: 0 ok, 2 page/API unreachable, 3 no video link
found, 4 file download failed, 5 placeholder pages on every attempt,
6 JSON mode supports facebook and tiktok links only.

## Rules

- Public content only. Login-walled/private videos and stories are not
  downloadable — report this, do not retry blindly.
- TikTok needs a direct video link (`.../video/<ID>`); `/foryou` feed links
  contain no video — ask the user for the specific link.
- Bare links work (`facebook.com/...` without `https://` is auto-completed).
- Verify downloads: real MP4 starts with bytes `00 00 00 .. 66 74 79 70`
  (`ftyp`); a file starting with `3C` (`<`) is an HTML error page.
- Facebook downloads may take minutes (up to 10 automatic attempts across
  qualities). Wait instead of re-issuing the command.
- Never invent `c_user`/`xs` cookie values — only use user-pasted ones.

## Source layout

- `src/cli_runner.tkv` (entry `main`), `src/gui_runner.tkv` (entry `run`),
  `src/core_engine.tkv` (URL detection, Facebook/TikTok resolvers, retry).
- `il_features/win32_gui_window.tkv`: WinForms UI + embedded-CIL download
  engine (HLS parser, InnerTube transcript, Facebook/TikTok branches).
- `il_features/stdlib_http*.tkv`: `http_get`, `http_get_h`, `http_post`,
  `http_download_file`, `http_request` builtins (modern TLS enforced).
- `il_features/stdlib_os.tkv`, `il_features/file_io.tkv`: `os_system`
  (POSIX-aware: `/bin/sh` vs `cmd.exe`), `file_delete`, file IO.

## TokenVector language essentials

- Statically-typed `.tkv` syntax: `def f(x: "str") -> "i32"`, classes,
  `__tkv_import__`. Types: `str`, `i32`, `i64`, `f64`.
- No explicitly-typed locals (`h = 0`, never `h: "i32" = 0`); no `ord()`;
  slicing only as a direct assignment RHS (`sub = s[i:j]`); `str()` on
  simple variables only; value-returning builtins must be assigned
  (`pad = thread_sleep(5000)`), except `void` builtins (`print`,
  `write_file`, `file_delete`, `os_system`).
- Strings: `len`, `find(sub[, start])`, `startswith`, `endswith`,
  `replace`, `strip`, `upper`, `lower`; concatenate with `+`.
- `if/elif/else`, `while`, `for i in range(n)`, `try/except Exception`,
  list literals + indexing + `len()`, dicts via `h = {}` + `h["k"] = v`.
- CIL gotchas: keep return types/values type-consistent (`i32`, Mono
  rejects `i32`-in-`i64` returns); exit `try` blocks only with `leave`;
  prefer long branches (`br`, `bge`) over short ones (`.s` range limits).

## Build and test

- Compiler: `tkvc` from https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector
  (place `tkvc.exe`/`tkvc` next to the scripts; it is NOT in this repo).
- Windows: `.\build.bat`. Linux/macOS: `./build.sh`.
  Single targets: `tkvc build src/gui_runner.tkv --entry run --out
  bin/tv-downloader-gui.exe`, `tkvc build src/cli_runner.tkv --entry
  main --out bin/tv-downloader-cli.exe`. Copy tested binaries from `bin/`
  to the repo root for release.
- Unit-test `.tkv` logic with a temporary `src/*_selftest.tkv` harness
  (`__tkv_import__ = "core_engine"`), build to `bin/`, run, then delete it.
- Linux check: `mono tv-downloader-cli.exe <link>` under WSL; GUI under
  `Xvfb` + screenshot. CI: `.github/workflows/test.yml` (3 OSes).
